title: Epoch replay changes the next proposal
evidence_status: DETERMINISTIC ILLUSTRATION: a constructed rule system, not a learned-model or real-agent result
selection_rule: Four deliberately constructed cases expose improvement, regression, stable success, and persistent failure. They are not sampled from a task population.
executor_contract: One deterministic formatter is replayed under both memory policies. Scalar and CSV formats obey the memory unit rule; a score is unchanged. The range renderer deliberately emits only the lower endpoint under both policies, modeling an unresolved parser limitation. No learned model is called.

reflection_rules.condition: A scalar requirement changes from fail to pass in an improved case
reflection_rules.action: Retain that scalar requirement and cite the case

reflection_rules.condition: A numeric CSV cell changes from pass to fail in a regressed case
reflection_rules.action: Remove csv from allow_inline; protect csv.numeric; cite the case

reflection_rules.condition: A requirement fails in both memory states
reflection_rules.action: Carry that requirement into open issues and cite the case

reflection_rules.condition: All requirements pass in both memory states

proposal_contract: Intersect requested formats with allow_inline. Attach retained requirements, protected contracts, unresolved issues and their evidence IDs. Emit a proposal artifact only: do not apply it or claim validation.
